item.title: By: Dan Littler
item.dc:creator: Dan Littler
item.description:
I've thought for a while that the word "love" damages the fidelity of words, even before I knew of taoist ideas. More so than any emotion or concept, each person carries a unique perspective on what love means, and each definition contains numerous complex variables.
I was amused and impressed you found a photo of a wolf in sheep's clothing, or did you have to photoshop it yourself?
